name: cadenus
note: Verification certificate for the ACA Cadenus sheet worked example. Keyword EASY, numeric key 2-1-3-4. The sheet prints the plaintext as 'A severe limitation on the usefulness of the Cadenus is that every message must be a multiple of twenty-five letters long.' Spaces and the hyphen in twenty-five are not enciphered. plaintext_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the 100 uppercase letters with no spaces. The sheet groups the ciphertext in blocks of five; those spaces are not in the ciphertext field. Checks the published example, not an unknown script. Not a reading of Linear A, Indus, Voynich, rongorongo, Kryptos K4, or army message Nr. 86.
